dt-example.title: User controlled properties
dt-example.info:
StateRestore has the ability to either include, exclude or allow the user to select if a property in a DataTables state object is to be included in the saved state or not. It is important to note here that the states stored by StateRestore can be partial states - so for example, you could have it save the search properties, but not the paging and ordering information.
You can either force the inclusion or exclusion of a state property, but you can also let the end user make the decision themselves. This is done with the `-init stateRestore.include` object. Setting the properties to `null` will result in a checkbox being shown to the end user, allowing them to select the parts of the state they want to save.
In this example, paging, ordering and global search options are provided to the user.
